scripts.build: node daemon/build.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs && node ui/build.mjs
scripts.dist: node scripts/build-helper.mjs && npm run build && cd ui && cmd.exe /c "npx electron-builder --win"
scripts.dist:linux: node daemon/build.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs && node ui/build.mjs && cd ui && npx electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:mac: node daemon/build.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs && node ui/build.mjs && cd ui && npx electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64
